newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian commits suicide over Miss World pageant.
newsitem.headline: Indian commits suicide over Miss World pageant.

text.p: A 24-year-old Indian man committed suicide by self-immolation on Thursday in protest against India staging the Miss World pageant, the United News of India (UNI) reported.
The agency said Suresh Kumar, a tailor, shouted anti-pageant slogans as he set fire to himself at a bus stand in the southern city of Madurai.
UNI said Kumar, a member of the Marxist-led Democratic Youth Federation of India, was rushed to hospital, where he died.

The pageant, to be held in the southern city of Bangalore on November 23, has attracted protests since one of India's most popular film stars, Amitabh Bachchan, announced it would be held in India for the first time.

More than 20 groups have come out in protest against the pageant. A women's organisation, the Mahila Jagran Samiti (Forum for Awakening Women), said members would commit suicide by self-immolation in protest.
